author: TylerdotMichael
body:
IGN: TylerdotMichael
Mod: Junr
Reason: Team Troll

Explanation: I would like to appeal this infraction as it was not a team trolling - instead it was a mod walking onto a situation not knowing the whole story.

On the map that is Bananas vs Apples, TwentyOneNemos and another player (Princess something) were digging each other into a whole in front of spawn. Clearly they were goofing around and not playing. Since Nemo is one of my team members on Cacal, we give each other a hard time from time to time. I placed a few sand and gravel blocks down there to trap him - Princess was building up out of the hole. It did cause him to get stuck in a block but he did not die as he broke it. He had made a funny comment back. I placed another gravel block causing him to get stuck again and before I could break it - as this one he did not break fast, Junr kicked me for team trolling.

If this was someone I did not know, or was on a tournament team with, I could clearly agree that this was trolling. But because Nemo is on my team and we are friends who were just goofing around. I did not keep placing them to cause him to die. He did not ask me to stop. He was not playing the game but goofing around as well.

For Junr, coming on to the end of that situation I can understand why he kicked me. But he did not: ask me once to not do that, ask what was going on, or find out any information before he kicked me. Normally mods ask a player a few times what they are doing before they put out a punishment. If he had asked me to stop I would of; if he asked me why I am doing that I would of explained that nemo and me were goofing around.

I have no personal problems with Junr, prior to this, and has been a great mod from what I have seen. And I am positive that Nemo can testify for me that what I did was not to be a troll but was to be funny and give him a hard time. 

I am not the type of player who trolls random people. I am the type that reports them. I even take reports and post them on the forms when mods are not on. I am a responsible player and I think it is VERY unjust to have this infraction on my account for two reasons: 1. Nemo and I were goofing around not harming anyone 2. Junr gave the kick without asking any information about the situation.

Thank you for taking the time to read this. If, whoever reviews this, has any further questions please let me know.

title: Kick Infraction Appeal

replies.author: Junr
replies.body: I'm sorry about the inconvenience, but in my perspective, it looked like you were team trolling. Even if you were messing around, you still have to obey the rules. Make sure you re-read the rules since there was some changes to it.

replies.author: TylerdotMichael
replies.body: Junr, is this the final decision on this appeal or will another staff member be taking a look at this?
replies.body_tagged: Junr, is this the final decision on this appeal or will another staff member be taking a look at this?

replies.author: Junr
replies.body:
It is the final decision, which makes this appeal, Denied. Thank you for being respectful.
This appeal will be open for the next 24 hours.

replies.author: TylerdotMichael
replies.body:
While I appreciate your timely response, I do not agree. What I am having a hard time wrapping my mind around is what is the point of the appeal process if the person who gave the punishment makes the call on that appeal. Shouldn't another mod make that call? I am not calling you biased at all, but being the one that made the report/punishment then making the verdict on whether or not to remove it does not seem right.

Plus, shouldn't you talk to the other player involved to gather information and decide if it was an ill intent movement I was doing?

Like I stated above and will say again, I was not trying to kill Nemo. If I was trying to do that I would have blocked the hole that was 4x4 on all sides. The sand pushed him to the side. The sand trapped him once but he got out, if he did not I was going to get him out. I placed a few more blocks moving him, then a gravel block to push him again which did not have that effect and started to suffocate him. Before I could break it I got kicked.

At no point was I trying to kill Nemo, simply push him aside and goof around. It takes quite some time to die suffocating in a block, knowing this if the block didn't push him I could have corrected it. I would not do something that would cause another player to die on the server. Again, I was goofing around with Nemo making blocks push him, not trying to kill him. There is a big difference between the two: 1. Placing blocks to push him and 2. Placing lots of blocks so he could not escape and would suffocate.

I am not in any way trying to say you (Junr) made a bad call. Giving coming in on the last second of what had happened I can understand that call. The point of me filling this out was to give all the information as to what had happen and have another mod make that call with all the information. But if you still do not agree with that, making the final call on a report/punishment you made instead of another staff member does not seem right to me - and I am not okay with.

replies.body: Thank you so much Junr. I want to apologize for causing the start of this whole debacle. I will make sure I am more careful about my actions and think them out fully when trying to be goofy. Like I said, none of this was ever in any ill intent and I really do appreciate it a lot that you took the time to discuss this with me. Look forward to playing with you online!
